sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: Today.

sentences.en: A Times investigation has revealed how applesauce laced with high levels of lead, which poisoned hundreds of children across the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的一项调查揭露了掺有高浓度铅的苹果泥是如何毒害了全美数百名儿童的，

sentences.en: sailed through a food safety system meant to protect American consumers.
sentences.zh: 并顺利通过了旨在保护美国消费者的食品安全系统。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Christina Jewett, about what she found.
sentences.zh: 我与我的同事克里斯蒂娜·朱厄特谈了谈她的发现。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月29日，星期四。

sentences.en: Christina, where does this story start?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，这个故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: So last summer, families all over America started to have sort of a mysterious problem.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，全美各地的家庭开始遇到一种奇怪的问题。

sentences.en: Their kids had startlingly high blood lead levels.
sentences.zh: 他们的孩子血液中铅含量高得惊人。

sentences.en: And this is extremely alarming for all these families because lead poisoning can lead to behavior problems, learning problems, developmental problems as well.
sentences.zh: 这对所有家庭来说都极其令人担忧，因为铅中毒会导致行为问题、学习障碍以及发育问题。

sentences.en: And basically, no one knows where this is coming from.
sentences.zh: 基本上，没人知道这是从哪儿来的。

sentences.en: Our daughter loves makeup and doing her nails.
sentences.zh: 我们的女儿喜欢化妆和做指甲。

sentences.en: Dresses.
sentences.zh: 穿裙子。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And our son loves cars and airplanes.
sentences.zh: 我们的儿子喜欢汽车和飞机。

sentences.en: Loud exhauSt.
sentences.zh: 吵闹的排气管。

sentences.en: And one of the families in this situation is Nicole Peterson and Thomas Young.
sentences.zh: 妮可·彼得森和托马斯·杨就是处于这种情况的家庭之一。

sentences.en: They have two little kids, a little boy who's one and a daughter who's three.
sentences.zh: 他们有两个小孩，一个一岁的男孩和一个三岁的女儿。

sentences.en: And our son had gone to his first annual checkup.
sentences.zh: 我们的儿子去做了第一次年度体检。

sentences.en: And they did a finger prick and his blood level is high.
sentences.zh: 他们做了指尖采血，结果显示他血液中的铅含量很高。

sentences.en: And during their routine pediatric visits for the summer, they learn that the kids have high blood blood levels.
sentences.zh: 在夏天例行的儿科就诊期间，他们得知孩子们的血铅水平很高。

sentences.en: We're talking about triple to quadruple the CDC's level of concern, basically.
sentences.zh: 我们说的是基本上达到了疾控中心警戒水平的三到四倍。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: It's kind of like a nightmare, right?
sentences.zh: 这就像一场噩梦，对吧？

sentences.en: It was tough.
sentences.zh: 那段日子很难熬。

sentences.en: Very tough.
sentences.zh: 非常难熬。

sentences.en: So that gets reported to the county.
sentences.zh: 这被上报给了县里。

sentences.en: The health department sends out an inspector.
sentences.zh: 卫生部门派了一名检查员。

sentences.en: He goes through their house with sort of this lead X-ray gun.
sentences.zh: 他带着那种铅检测X射线枪检查了他们的房子。

sentences.en: And he's shooting everything.
sentences.zh: 他到处扫描。

sentences.en: Every pot, pan, toys.
sentences.zh: 每一个锅、平底锅、玩具。

sentences.en: I'm opening the rice cooker, you know, to literally test everything.
sentences.zh: 我打开电饭煲，你知道，真的是在测试每一件东西。

sentences.en: This is a five-hour process.
sentences.zh: 这是一个持续五个小时的过程。

sentences.en: The door frame, there was something in there, but there was no concern because there was no chipping nowhere to.
sentences.zh: 门框上确实检测出了一些东西，但因为没有剥落，没有接触点，所以并不令人担心。

sentences.en: It was encapsulated is what he had mentioned.
sentences.zh: 他提到那是被封装起来的。

sentences.en: He finds some lead in a doorway in the basement.
sentences.zh: 他在地下室的一个门框里发现了一些铅。

sentences.en: He finds lead in a figurine that's sort of a family heirloom.
sentences.zh: 他在一个算是传家宝的小雕像里发现了铅。

sentences.en: Some antique birds that my grandmother had given me, you know, but out of reach.
sentences.zh: 那是我祖母给我的一些古董鸟摆件，你知道，但放在够不着的地方。

sentences.en: They're seasonal.
sentences.zh: 它们是季节性摆放的。

sentences.en: They don't, the kids are not putting them in their mouth.
sentences.zh: 孩子们不会把它们放进嘴里。

sentences.en: None of these things are what the kids are touching or eating or are really playing with at all.
sentences.zh: 这些东西都不是孩子们会接触、食用或真正玩耍的。

sentences.en: So it was really sort of a mystery.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是个谜。

sentences.en: And then the kids are screened again.
sentences.zh: 然后孩子们又接受了筛查。

sentences.en: They get checked in the middle of AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 他们在8月中旬接受了检查。

sentences.en: And their lead level doubled.
sentences.zh: 结果他们的铅含量翻了一番。

sentences.en: And the numbers have gone up into the 20s.
sentences.zh: 数值上升到了20多。

sentences.en: And so now.
sentences.zh: 所以现在。

sentences.en: I was 24.
sentences.zh: 我当时是24。

sentences.en: Yeah, everyone is, of course, very, very concerned, freaking out.
sentences.zh: 是的，每个人当然都非常、非常担心，都要崩溃了。

sentences.en: They're saying that this has never happened before in county history, that this is the first time that they've seen this.
sentences.zh: 他们说这在县历史上从未发生过，这是他们第一次见到这种情况。

sentences.en: Thomas and I weren't sleeping or not eating.
sentences.zh: 托马斯和我当时吃不下睡不着。

sentences.en: Like, this is driving us crazy and tormenting us.
sentences.zh: 这简直让我们发疯，折磨着我们。

sentences.en: So the family is freaking out.
sentences.zh: 所以这家人都要崩溃了。

sentences.en: The parents get their levels tested and it's normal.
sentences.zh: 父母也去测了血铅，结果是正常的。

sentences.en: So now they're really, really facing a mystery.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他们真的面临着一个谜团。

sentences.en: I mean, what are the kids exposed to that the parents are not?
sentences.zh: 我是说，孩子们接触了什么而父母没有接触呢？

sentences.en: So the county goes out to the daycare, looks at everything there.
sentences.zh: 于是县里的人去了日托中心，检查了那里的一切。

sentences.en: They spent a few hours at the daycare.
sentences.zh: 他们在日托中心待了几个小时。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么也没发现。

sentences.en: They didn't really have any answers.
sentences.zh: 他们真的没有任何答案。

sentences.en: They really didn't know where to guide us or guide us in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 他们真的不知道该引导我们去哪里，或者指引我们正确的方向。

sentences.en: And then the parents start a food diary.
sentences.zh: 然后父母开始记录饮食日记。

sentences.en: We all eat the same food.
sentences.zh: 我们都吃一样的食物。

sentences.en: We don't eat different food.
sentences.zh: 我们不吃不同的食物。

sentences.en: The kids don't get one meal and we get another meal.
sentences.zh: 孩子们不会吃一顿饭，我们吃另一顿。

sentences.en: And they realize that there's one thing that the kids eat that they don't.
sentences.zh: 然后他们意识到孩子们吃的东西里有一样是他们不吃的。

sentences.en: The only thing that they eat that we don't eat are these pouches.
sentences.zh: 他们吃而我们不吃的唯一东西就是这些果泥袋。

sentences.en: And it's these foil packets of cinnamon applesauce that the family gives the kids as a routine snack.
sentences.zh: 那是家人给孩子们作为日常零食的肉桂苹果泥铝箔袋。

sentences.en: And they loved it.
sentences.zh: 他们很喜欢。

sentences.en: They would devour it and they would eat it on the playground if they were just out and about, you know, because...
sentences.zh: 他们会狼吞虎咽地吃掉，如果他们在外面玩，也会在操场上吃，你知道，因为……

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, every parent, me included, gives their kids a pouch of applesauce.
sentences.zh: 我是说，每个家长，包括我，都会给孩子一袋苹果泥。

sentences.en: It is the universal food of the American toddler.
sentences.zh: 这是美国幼儿的通用食品。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what happens once the family narrows this down to applesauce?
sentences.zh: 那么当这家人把范围缩小到苹果泥后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So the county health inspector comes out.
sentences.zh: 县里的卫生检查员来了。

sentences.en: They take samples of the packets.
sentences.zh: 他们取了这些包装袋的样本。

sentences.en: They take it to the state health lab in North Carolina and they run some tests.
sentences.zh: 他们把样本送到北卡罗来纳州的州立卫生实验室进行了一些测试。

sentences.en: I think they contacted us on Friday.
sentences.zh: 我想他们是在周五联系我们的。

sentences.en: Yeah, they called us on a Friday and said that they had gotten the report back from the lab and then they had tested positive.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们在周五打电话给我们，说他们收到了实验室的报告，结果呈阳性。

sentences.en: And what they find is basically an incredibly high level of lead in this applesauce.
sentences.zh: 他们发现的是这种苹果泥中含有极高浓度的铅。

sentences.en: They forward that to the FDA, which quickly turns around and works with the company that made it to issue a recall.
sentences.zh: 他们将此转交给美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA），FDA迅速采取行动，与生产商合作发布了召回令。

sentences.en: It was just so nice to have, like, a resolution.
sentences.zh: 能有一个结果真是太好了。

sentences.en: Like, we know where this is coming from now and we don't have to drive ourselves crazy in this constant nightmare.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我们现在知道这是从哪儿来的了，不必再在这场持续的噩梦中让自己发疯了。

sentences.en: It's nice to have an answer.
sentences.zh: 能得到答案真好。

sentences.en: And so millions of these packets that were sold at Dollar Tree under the name Wanabana and also at Schnucks Market and Weiss Market grocery stores under the store brand,
sentences.zh: 于是，数百万袋在Dollar Tree以Wanabana品牌销售，以及在Schnucks Market和Weiss Market超市以自有品牌销售的产品，

sentences.en: those are all recalled.
sentences.zh: 全部被召回了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And then the FDA tries to figure out how this lead got into the applesauce in the first place.
sentences.zh: 然后FDA试图弄清楚这些铅最初是如何进入苹果泥的。

sentences.en: And what do they find?
sentences.zh: 他们发现了什么？

sentences.en: So they pretty quickly narrow in on the cinnamon in the applesauce.
sentences.zh: 他们很快将目标锁定在苹果泥中的肉桂上。

sentences.en: There's this known problem in the spice industry where sometimes people will add lead chromate powder to sort of make the color pop.
sentences.zh: 香料行业有一个众所周知的问题，有时人们会添加铬酸铅粉末来让颜色更鲜艳。

sentences.en: And what is lead chromate, Christina?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，什么是铬酸铅？

sentences.en: Lead chromate is an orange-yellow powder.
sentences.zh: 铬酸铅是一种橙黄色的粉末。

sentences.en: It's still used in industrial applications overseas.
sentences.zh: 它在海外仍被用于工业用途。

sentences.en: And even though it's toxic, sometimes people illegally add it to spices, especially with turmeric or curry powder, that sometimes this is poured in to sort of bulk up the spices.
sentences.zh: 尽管它有毒，但有时人们会非法将其添加到香料中，特别是姜黄或咖喱粉，有时会倒入其中以增加香料的重量。

sentences.en: Like a drug dealer sort of cuts the cocaine with flour or sugar or something.
sentences.zh: 就像毒贩用面粉或糖之类的东西掺杂可卡因一样。

sentences.en: So the FDA is realizing that could be what was happening in Ecuador where this applesauce was processed.
sentences.zh: 所以FDA意识到这可能就是厄瓜多尔加工这种苹果泥时发生的情况。

sentences.en: And officials from Ecuador are able to trace the cinnamon in the applesauce up the supply chain to a spice grinder who they think is responsible.
sentences.zh: 厄瓜多尔的官员能够顺着供应链追溯到苹果泥中的肉桂，找到了他们认为负责的香料研磨商。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So the FDA suspects that somebody grinding cinnamon is adding lead chromate to it basically to make more money on the production of that cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 所以FDA怀疑有人在研磨肉桂时添加了铬酸铅，基本上是为了在肉桂生产中赚更多的钱。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then it went to the company that made the applesauce, which shipped it off to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后它被送到了生产苹果泥的公司，该公司将其运往美国。

sentences.en: It landed in the ports of Baltimore and Miami and ended up right on grocery shelves to be handed to American infants and toddlers.
sentences.zh: 它抵达了巴尔的摩和迈阿密的港口，最终直接摆上了超市货架，被送到美国婴儿和幼儿手中。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And how many children, Christina, ended up consuming this lead-poisoned applesauce?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，最终有多少儿童食用了这种铅中毒的苹果泥？

sentences.en: We know the kids in 44 states had this applesauce.
sentences.zh: 我们知道44个州的儿童都吃过这种苹果泥。

sentences.en: The CDC has said that about 468 kids consumed this applesauce and had high levels of lead in their blood.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心表示，约有468名儿童食用了这种苹果泥，且血液中铅含量很高。

sentences.en: The median level of lead in their blood was about six times higher than what we saw with the Flint lead and water crisis about a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 他们血液中的铅含量中位数比大约十年前弗林特铅水危机中观察到的水平高出约六倍。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And as far as how many kids total, it could be so many more.
sentences.zh: 至于总共有多少孩子，可能远不止这些。

sentences.en: There's probably plenty of parents who didn't have a blood screening, who didn't connect it to the applesauce.
sentences.zh: 可能有很多家长没有进行血液筛查，也没有将其与苹果泥联系起来。

sentences.en: And there's certainly others that didn't meet the case definition by the time this was discovered, which, you know, required a certain level of lead in the blood.
sentences.zh: 当然还有其他人，在发现这个问题时，他们还没达到病例定义的标准，你知道，这需要血液中达到一定的铅含量。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So you're saying at the very least, nearly 500 very small children were consuming this contaminated applesauce and it's discovered that their blood is filled with lead.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说至少有近500名非常小的孩子食用了这种受污染的苹果泥，并且发现他们的血液中充满了铅。

sentences.en: That's the very best case scenario.
sentences.zh: 那是最好的情况了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is one of the worst toxic exposures of U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是美国几十年来最严重的儿童中毒事件之一。

sentences.en: kids in decades.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，这就是你和《时报》介入的地方，对吧？

sentences.en: And this, Christina, is where you and the Times come in, right?
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 我负责报道FDA，它拥有庞大的基础设施来保护我们的食品供应。

sentences.en: I cover the FDA, which has a big infrastructure to protect our food supply.
sentences.zh: 所以我想了解这是如何发生的。

sentences.en: And so I wanted to understand how this occurred.
sentences.zh: 因此，我与另一位记者威尔·菲茨吉本合作，他为一家名为“调查”（The Examination）的非营利组织工作。

sentences.en: So I teamed up with another reporter, Will Fitzgibbon, who works for a nonprofit called The Examination.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全球健康新闻机构。

sentences.en: It's a global health news organization.
sentences.zh: 我们最终从厄瓜多尔获得了数千页的文件，追踪了他们的调查，并采访了许多食品安全专家，真正弄清楚了系统是如何未能检测出基本上是有毒的苹果泥进入全美各地的超市货架的。

sentences.en: And we wound up getting thousands of pages of documents from Ecuador tracing their investigation and interviewed a number of food safety experts to really figure out how the system failed to detect basically poisonous applesauce going on to store shelves all over America.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 因为理想情况下，你应该在苹果泥进入食品供应系统之前就发现它被铅污染了，而不是在它进入幼儿血液之后。

sentences.en: Because ideally, you discover that applesauce is poisoned with lead before it enters the food supply system, not after it's entered the blood of little children.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 我采访的一位专家基本上说，在这种情况下，孩子们就像煤矿里的金丝雀，

sentences.en: One expert I talked to basically said in this situation, the kids were like the canary in the coal mine,
sentences.zh: 这并不是你在一个拥有先进食品安全系统的国家里想看到的情况。

sentences.en: which is not what you want to see happen in a country with a sophisticated food safety system.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏《Connections》。

sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基（Sam Azersky），我每天负责制作《拼字蜜蜂》（Spelling Bee）和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”（promesthesia）的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的那些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games，立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So once you all conduct this investigation, what do you find?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你们进行这项调查后，你们发现了什么？

sentences.en: How did our regulatory system allow this applesauce to enter the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 我们的监管体系是如何允许这种苹果酱进入美国的？

sentences.en: So in the U.S., the food safety system is pretty robuSt.
sentences.zh: 在美国，食品安全体系相当健全。

sentences.en: There are boots on the ground in every state, routine inspections of food-making facilities, and there's some precedent of criminal prosecutions for big failures.
sentences.zh: 每个州都有实地工作人员，会对食品生产设施进行例行检查，而且对于重大失职行为，也有过刑事起诉的先例。

sentences.en: So things like salmonella and listeria get discovered pretty routinely.
sentences.zh: 所以像沙门氏菌和李斯特菌这类问题通常都能被及时发现。

sentences.en: The biggest fears have always been about food that comes from outside the U.S., where we know less.
sentences.zh: 人们最大的担忧一直来自于美国境外的食品，因为我们对那里的了解较少。

sentences.en: You know, there can be things added for financial gain.
sentences.zh: 你知道，为了经济利益，可能会有人往里添加东西。

sentences.en: There can be pesticides we don't allow in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 也可能含有我们在美国禁止使用的农药。

sentences.en: And these fears really grow in the late 2000s with a scandal in China.
sentences.zh: 这些担忧在21世纪00年代末因中国的一起丑闻而真正加剧了。

sentences.en: It's all about the chemical melamine.
sentences.zh: 这一切都与三聚氰胺这种化学物质有关。

sentences.en: It can make protein levels look normal in quality tests if milk has been watered down to cheat consumers.
sentences.zh: 如果牛奶被兑水以欺骗消费者，三聚氰胺可以让蛋白质含量在质量检测中看起来正常。

sentences.en: People were adding this powder called melamine to infant formula and pet food.
sentences.zh: 当时有人在婴儿配方奶粉和宠物食品中添加了这种叫三聚氰胺的粉末。

sentences.en: And what it did was mimic protein powder, but it was also really toxic.
sentences.zh: 它的作用是模拟蛋白质粉，但同时也具有剧毒。

sentences.en: Nervous parents have rushed children to hospitals when it was revealed baby formula was laced with the industrial chemical melamine.
sentences.zh: 当婴儿奶粉被曝掺入工业化学品三聚氰胺时，焦虑的父母们纷纷将孩子送往医院。

sentences.en: So six babies died in China.
sentences.zh: 当时中国有六名婴儿死亡。

sentences.en: Why didn't the government test the formula more carefully, asked this mother.
sentences.zh: 一位母亲质问道，为什么政府没有更仔细地检测奶粉？

sentences.en: Hundreds of thousands of babies overseas got sick.
sentences.zh: 海外有成千上万的婴儿因此生病。

sentences.en: And dogs and cats all around America got sick and also died.
sentences.zh: 美国各地的猫狗也生病甚至死亡。

sentences.en: It's a black eye for China's leadership.
sentences.zh: 这对中国领导层来说是一个污点。

sentences.en: Consumer confidence in Chinese goods is falling to an all-time low.
sentences.zh: 消费者对中国商品的信心降到了历史最低点。

sentences.en: I remember this really well, and it was seen as a wake-up call that there are some really bad actors in the world when it comes to food and food safety.
sentences.zh: 我对此记忆犹新，这被视为一个警钟，提醒人们在食品和食品安全方面，世界上确实存在一些非常恶劣的参与者。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that creates some impetus to change the way the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这促使美国开始改变监管方式，

sentences.en: oversees food that's imported from outside the U.S.
sentences.zh: 以加强对美国境外进口食品的监管。

sentences.en: And that winds up sort of coming together in 2011 with President Obama signing the Food Safety Modernization Act.
sentences.zh: 这一切最终在2011年汇聚在一起，奥巴马总统签署了《食品安全现代化法案》。

sentences.en: That does a number of things.
sentences.zh: 该法案做了很多事情。

sentences.en: One of them is to really try to plug the holes in the system of imported food that are meant to prevent, really, what happened in China from happening again in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是真正试图堵住进口食品体系中的漏洞，旨在防止中国发生的事情在美国重演。

sentences.en: And how does the new law envision that working?
sentences.zh: 那么新法律是如何设想这一点的呢？

sentences.en: Well, it does two big things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它做了两件大事。

sentences.en: One is there would be more overseas inspections of food-making facilities.
sentences.zh: 一是增加对海外食品生产设施的检查。

sentences.en: So the FDA would actually send people into the food plants.
sentences.zh: FDA（美国食品药品监督管理局）实际上会派人进入食品工厂。

sentences.en: They would take a look at all their processes, their procedures, their test results,
sentences.zh: 他们会查看所有的生产流程、程序和测试结果，

sentences.en: how they're making the food safer to come into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 以及他们是如何确保进入美国的食品更安全的。

sentences.en: And that was actually supposed to reach a level of 19,000 inspections like that per year.
sentences.zh: 这实际上本应达到每年1.9万次此类检查的水平。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So in short, they wanted to treat international inspections the way that they treat domestic ones.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他们希望像对待国内检查一样对待国际检查。

sentences.en: Make sure that there are a lot of them, that they're frequent, and that they're likely to catch things.
sentences.zh: 确保检查数量充足、频率高，并且能够发现问题。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The other thing it does is it puts U.S.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，它要求美国

sentences.en: import companies, companies that import food, and it essentially made them guardians of the food that comes into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 进口商，即那些进口食品的公司，本质上成为进入美国食品的守护者。

sentences.en: And they're not really used to having these food safety duties, but here they came anyway.
sentences.zh: 他们并不习惯承担这些食品安全职责，但无论如何，这些职责还是落到了他们头上。

sentences.en: And so what they're supposed to do is look at the food they're importing, identify the specific risks related to that food, and make sure those are dealt with.
sentences.zh: 所以他们应该做的是查看他们进口的食品，识别与该食品相关的特定风险，并确保这些风险得到处理。

sentences.en: And oftentimes, they do this with consultants, and they're required to hire auditors to make sure they're doing a good job of basically eliminating risks.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，他们会聘请顾问，并被要求雇佣审计员，以确保他们能很好地消除风险。

sentences.en: And sometimes these auditors go overseas and inspect the facilities on their behalf.
sentences.zh: 有时这些审计员会代表他们前往海外检查设施。

sentences.en: So on paper, this looks like a pretty tight ship, something that can keep the lead or the melamine out of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以从纸面上看，这看起来是一个相当严密的体系，足以将铅或三聚氰胺挡在美国之外。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And there's a redundancy at play here from what you just said, which is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且根据你刚才所说的，这里存在一种冗余，即美国

sentences.en: is going to be sending out inspectors itself to foreign food manufacturing facilities, and it's going to be asking food importers to do their own auditing of their suppliers.
sentences.zh: 不仅会亲自派遣检查员前往外国食品生产设施，还会要求食品进口商对供应商进行自己的审计。

sentences.en: So the thinking, I'm sure, is that between those two, something will be caught.
sentences.zh: 所以我敢肯定，他们的想法是，在这两者之间，总能发现问题。

sentences.en: Clearly, though, that didn't happen in the case of the applesauce.
sentences.zh: 然而，显然在苹果酱这件事上并没有发生这种情况。

sentences.en: So what did you learn about why that is?
sentences.zh: 那么你了解到这是为什么了吗？

sentences.en: So the law didn't quite work out as intended.
sentences.zh: 法律并没有完全按预期发挥作用。

sentences.en: The number of overseas inspections was supposed to reach 19,000.
sentences.zh: 海外检查的数量本应达到1.9万次。

sentences.en: Well, that didn't come to pass.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这并没有实现。

sentences.en: Last year, there were 1,200 inspections.
sentences.zh: 去年，检查次数为1200次。

sentences.en: And so that means FDA inspectors got to about 1% of the overseas food facilities.
sentences.zh: 这意味着FDA检查员只覆盖了大约1%的海外食品设施。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: A tiny percentage.
sentences.zh: 一个很小的比例。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And when it came to the company in Ecuador that made this applesauce, the company's called OstroFood, we found that the FDA hadn't been in that facility since 2019.
sentences.zh: 当谈到厄瓜多尔那家生产这种苹果酱的公司，即OstroFood公司时，我们发现FDA自2019年以来就没有去过该设施。

sentences.en: And when they were there, we don't think at the time they were using cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 而且当他们去的时候，我们认为当时他们并没有使用肉桂。

sentences.en: And overall, the FDA didn't find any problems that they recommended fixing.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，FDA没有发现任何需要修复的问题。

sentences.en: So I really wanted to pause on this.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很想在这里停顿一下。

sentences.en: No one from the United States government, despite the ambitions of this law, had visited the facility where this applesauce was made in the last five years.
sentences.zh: 尽管有这项法律的雄心，但在过去五年里，美国政府没有任何人访问过生产这种苹果酱的设施。

sentences.en: So if there were any problems with any product leaving those facilities and headed for the U.S., the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果离开这些设施并运往美国的任何产品有任何问题，美国

sentences.en: government had no eyes and no ears on any of it.
sentences.zh: 政府对此一无所知。

sentences.en: Not on site, no.
sentences.zh: 现场确实没有。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And when we took a look at the second line of defense that's supposed to keep things like toxic applesauce out of the U.S., the importers, we found out thousands of them
sentences.zh: 当我们审视本应将有毒苹果酱等产品挡在美国之外的第二道防线——进口商时，我们发现成千上万的进口商

sentences.en: just never set up programs to vet foreign food.
sentences.zh: 根本没有建立审查外国食品的程序。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So they hadn't taken up this guardian role that the government was trying to give them.
sentences.zh: 所以他们并没有承担起政府试图赋予他们的这种守护者角色。

sentences.en: In fact, the FDA has issued about 3,400 citations to companies that weren't doing this at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，FDA已经向那些根本没有履行职责的公司发出了大约3400份传票。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: So in this situation with the importers, no one would tell us exactly what happened with the applesauce.
sentences.zh: 所以在进口商的这种情况下，没有人能确切告诉我们苹果酱到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: But basically what we could piece together is that there was an auditor sent out to the applesauce making company in Ecuador late last year.
sentences.zh: 但基本上我们可以拼凑出的是，去年年底，一名审计员被派往厄瓜多尔的苹果酱生产公司。

sentences.en: And when they took a look around, they wound up giving this company a grade of A plus,
sentences.zh: 当他们四处查看时，最终给了这家公司一个A+的评级，

sentences.en: even as there are headlines all across the United States about kids being poisoned by lead-tainted applesauce.
sentences.zh: 尽管当时全美各地都在报道孩子们因铅污染的苹果酱而中毒的消息。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So in the case of the applesauce, you're saying the auditor working on behalf of an importer whose job it is now to protect U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以关于苹果酱的情况，你是说代表进口商工作的审计员，其职责现在是保护美国

sentences.en: consumers ends up issuing a pretty much perfect rating to the maker of this applesauce, even though, of course, we know that the applesauce is contaminated,
sentences.zh: 消费者，最终却给这家苹果酱制造商发出了几乎完美的评级，尽管我们当然知道苹果酱受到了污染，

sentences.en: suggesting that that auditor was clearly not doing their job very well.
sentences.zh: 这表明那位审计员显然没有很好地完成他们的工作。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And a lot of the experts we talked to said this is kind of an honor system.
sentences.zh: 我们采访的许多专家都说这是一种荣誉体系。

sentences.en: And when they say that, they're talking about the fact that all these companies have the discretion to choose which risks to worry about.
sentences.zh: 当他们这样说时，是指所有这些公司都有权决定担心哪些风险。

sentences.en: In this case, with this audit, it looks like the concern was salmonella.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，通过这次审计，看起来他们关注的是沙门氏菌。

sentences.en: So this lead that's widespread, well-known at this point, was a non-concern as far as that audit went.
sentences.zh: 所以这种目前已经广为人知的铅污染，在审计看来根本不是问题。

sentences.en: Christina, I'm curious.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，我很好奇。

sentences.en: In this American system, what you've described so far are the responsibilities of inspections overseas, whether that's done by the FDA at a manufacturing site
sentences.zh: 在这个美国体系中，你目前所描述的是海外检查的责任，无论是通过FDA在生产现场进行检查，

sentences.en: or by an importer who's supposed to hire an auditor to go to the facility.
sentences.zh: 还是由进口商雇佣审计员前往设施进行检查。

sentences.en: But once international food reaches the U.S., is there ever a moment where the American system kicks in and tests food, opens up a package or a pouch of applesauce and tests it?
sentences.zh: 但是一旦国际食品到达美国，美国体系是否会在某个时刻介入并测试食品，比如打开一包或一袋苹果酱进行检测？

sentences.en: You know, there is.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有的。

sentences.en: There are tests that occur at the border, at the ports of entry, and the inspectors will open up, you know, a pouch of applesauce and test it.
sentences.zh: 在边境和入境口岸会进行测试，检查员会打开一袋苹果酱进行检测。

sentences.en: But the number of these tests has actually gone down.
sentences.zh: 但这些测试的数量实际上已经减少了。

sentences.en: It's really fallen in half over the last decade.
sentences.zh: 在过去十年里，它确实减少了一半。

sentences.en: And at the same time, the number of imported food products has gone way up.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，进口食品的数量却大幅上升。

sentences.en: It's really at an all-time high, just down a hair from where it was in 2022.
sentences.zh: 它确实处于历史最高水平，仅比2022年的水平略低一点。

sentences.en: So in essence, the border searches, those are really like looking for a needle in a haystack.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，边境搜查就像大海捞针一样。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Based on your reporting, I wonder if you have concluded that what happened here is the fault of a poorly constructed law or its lax enforcement, or if this is just the reality
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，我想知道你是否得出结论：这里发生的事情是法律制定不当或执行不力造成的，还是这仅仅是现实，

sentences.en: that in a global food supply chain with so many elements and manufacturers and facilities, that it's just going to be hard to detect something like a malevolent cinnamon supplier,
sentences.zh: 即在一个拥有如此多要素、制造商和设施的全球食品供应链中，很难检测到像恶意的肉桂供应商那样的人，

sentences.en: you know, who adds a terrible toxin to food.
sentences.zh: 你知道，往食物里添加可怕的毒素。

sentences.en: I mean, yeah, I think in the best of systems, it's easy to envision how something could slip through.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是的，我认为在最好的体系中，也很容易想象某些东西会漏网。

sentences.en: But this is such a close parallel to what our nation really grappled with almost 15 years ago in creating this new system of inspections and audits.
sentences.zh: 但这与我们国家近15年前在创建这个新的检查和审计体系时所真正努力解决的问题非常相似。

sentences.en: And what our investigation found really was that the system's not living up to those requirements at all.
sentences.zh: 我们的调查发现，这个体系根本没有达到那些要求。

sentences.en: The inspections aren't anywhere close to where they were envisioned to be.
sentences.zh: 检查的数量远未达到预期的水平。

sentences.en: The audits that were supposed to be happening in many cases aren't happening at all.
sentences.zh: 本应进行的审计在许多情况下根本没有发生。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You're saying even the best of systems might not catch something, but we don't have the best of systeMs. We don't even have the system that the law requires.
sentences.zh: 你是说即使是最好的体系也可能无法发现某些问题，但我们并没有最好的体系。我们甚至连法律要求的体系都没有。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I want to return to the family that we met at the start of this conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以我想回到我们在对话开始时遇到的那个家庭。

sentences.en: How worried are they about what this lead poisoning will mean for those two very small children?
sentences.zh: 他们对这种铅中毒将给那两个年幼的孩子带来什么影响有多担心？

sentences.en: And what do we understand to be the prognosis for those two kids?
sentences.zh: 我们对这两个孩子的预后有什么了解吗？

sentences.en: Well, for all the families, the concern is that lead lives in the body forever.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于所有家庭来说，担忧的是铅会永远留在体内。

sentences.en: There are different, you know, junctures in your life where the lead can come out.
sentences.zh: 在你生命的不同阶段，铅可能会释放出来。

sentences.en: It's in the bones and your kid has a growth spurt and some of that lead can come out.
sentences.zh: 它存在于骨骼中，当你的孩子经历生长突增时，部分铅可能会释放出来。

sentences.en: You may develop osteoporosis and the lead can come out.
sentences.zh: 你可能会患上骨质疏松症，铅也可能会释放出来。

sentences.en: So there are lifelong ramifications.
sentences.zh: 所以会有终身的影响。

sentences.en: And for Nicole and Thomas, the family we met from North
sentences.zh: 对于我们见到的来自北卡罗来纳州的妮可（Nicole）和托马斯（Thomas）一家，

sentences.en: Carolina, the health system takes this very seriously.
sentences.zh: 卫生系统非常重视这一点。

sentences.en: So they've been provided with nutritional counseling.
sentences.zh: 所以他们得到了营养咨询。

sentences.en: They've been provided with specialists to help the kids meet their developmental milestones.
sentences.zh: 他们得到了专家帮助，以确保孩子们达到发育里程碑。

sentences.en: But there is a sense that things will never be quite the same for them.
sentences.zh: 但人们有一种感觉，他们的情况永远不会完全恢复如初了。

sentences.en: They can't just walk into the grocery store, toss things into the cart blithely without having a second thought.
sentences.zh: 他们不能再随随便便走进杂货店，不假思索地把东西扔进购物车了。

sentences.en: After what happened to their young children, there'll be a lingering sense, I would imagine, that the system really did fail them.
sentences.zh: 在他们的年幼孩子遭遇这些事情之后，我想他们会有一种挥之不去的感触，那就是这个体系确实辜负了他们。

sentences.en: Well, Christina, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，克里斯蒂娜，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰（Benjamin Poulin）。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森（Mark Ronson）。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一档关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in night clubs in the era of vinyl, every night, you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代在夜店当DJ的时候，每天晚上，你都要带着300件你最珍贵的财产去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你会把DJ台变成一个充满美丽的50年历史文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platform.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: One of life's most underappreciated talents is to know when it's time to move on to life's next chapter.
sentences.zh: 人生中最被低估的天赋之一，就是知道何时该开启人生的下一个篇章。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Senator Mitch McConnell of Kentucky, the leader of the Senate Republicans for the past two decades, said he would give up that role at the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 周三，过去二十年来一直担任参议院共和党领袖的肯塔基州参议员米奇·麦康奈尔（Mitch McConnell）表示，他将在年底卸任该职务。

sentences.en: During a speech on the Senate floor announcing the decision, McConnell acknowledged that his policies, especially his view that supporting Ukraine is essential to U.S.
sentences.zh: 在参议院宣布这一决定的演讲中，麦康奈尔承认，他的政策，特别是他认为支持乌克兰对美国国家安全至关重要的观点，

sentences.en: national security, are increasingly out of step with the rest of his party and its de facto presidential nominee, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 与他所在政党的其余成员及其事实上的总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）越来越不合拍。

sentences.en: Believe me, I know the politics within my party at this particular moment in time.
sentences.zh: 相信我，我了解此时此刻我党内的政治局势。

sentences.en: I have many faults.
sentences.zh: 我有很多缺点。

sentences.en: Misunderstanding politics is not one of them.
sentences.zh: 误解政治并不在其中。

sentences.en: And in a stunning admission of financial strain, Trump said he could offer a bond of only $100 million
sentences.zh: 在一项令人震惊的财务困境声明中，特朗普表示他只能提供1亿美元的保证金，

sentences.en: toward a Manhattan court judgment of $450 million that he must pay in the coming weeks.
sentences.zh: 以应对他未来几周内必须支付的4.5亿美元曼哈顿法院判决。

sentences.en: If that bond is not accepted, Trump said he may need to sell some of his properties to come up with more cash.
sentences.zh: 特朗普表示，如果该保证金不被接受，他可能需要出售部分房产以筹集更多现金。

sentences.en: The admission, made in a court filing, highlights the degree to which the $450 million
sentences.zh: 这份在法庭文件中做出的陈述，凸显了这4.5亿美元的罚款——

sentences.en: penalty, punishment for a years-long financial fraud, has created a cash crunch for the former president.
sentences.zh: 作为对他多年金融欺诈的惩罚——已经给这位前总统造成了严重的现金流紧张。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Alex Stern, Rochelle Banja, and Diana Nguyen.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由Alex Stern、Rochelle Banja和Diana Nguyen制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Liz O.
sentences.zh: 由Liz O.编辑，

sentences.en: Balen, contains original music by Marian Lozano and Rowe Nemisto, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: Balen负责，包含Marian Lozano和Rowe Nemisto的原创音乐，并由Alyssa Moxley进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的Jim Brunberg和Ben Landsberg创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。
